units.label: the crossing save
units.cadence: 00:02 and 12:02 UTC, two minutes behind each crossing on purpose

units.label: the office's read index
units.cadence: every 15 minutes at :07, :22, :37, :52 — offset from the site extractor

units.label: the settlement shadow
units.cadence: 10:23 and 22:23 UTC — off the real crossing's 05:45/17:45 marks so the rehearsal never races the pen

units.label: the stripe watch (Stage B)
units.cadence: every 15 minutes at :07/:22/:37/:52 — offset from usdc-watch so the two funding watchers never contend for town.lock

units.label: the box publishes the site (atomic swap, lock, convergence)
units.cadence: every 30 minutes at :10/:40 — phased ~10 min after the ferry crossings

units.label: the World 2.0 candle
units.cadence: 05:45 and 17:45 UTC — the marks world LOGOS/classes.md § crossing ② holds until the w39 ship (2026-09-21), after which both this timer and postmark-settlement.timer read 06:00 and 18:00; the repo copies already carry the ship's marks and reach the box with the tag

units.label: the World 2.0 projection poll
units.cadence: none while parked (the unit file keeps its :04/:19/:34/:49 UTC OnCalendar for the day it is re-adopted)

units.label: the World 2.0 law pen
units.cadence: every 15 minutes, :04/:19/:34/:49 UTC — the same marks the parked poll carries, kept deliberately: they are off the :07/:22/:37/:52 that office-rehydrate and stripe-watch occupy, and a new cadence here would be a second decision riding along with the split

units.label: the World 2.0 notary
units.cadence: nightly at 07:20 UTC, jittered up to 2 min — after the morning crossing has published and its receipt has landed, so the certification reads the docket the crossing cleared (office#83; was 03:20, which read every docketed mark as canon-absent two hours before the crossing cleared it)

units.label: the World 2.0 durability lane
units.cadence: nightly at 08:10 UTC, jittered up to 5 min — after the notary (moved with it, office#83), so the night's certification has already been pushed to its own repo before the dump ships to this one
